about_the_game:
Possess Squad throws you into a post-apocalyptic world overrun by mutated infected.
Face escalating challenges through diverse missions: survive against the clock, protect fellow survivors, wipe out swarms of infected, destroy contaminated objects, hunt down mutant bosses, and reach safe havens.

Manage scarce resources such as food, medicine, artifacts, and weapons. Deal with NPCs who each have their own needs and trade offers.

Every mission ramps up in difficulty, even when objectives repeat, keeping the pressure high and the action intense.
Choose from a wide arsenal: brutal melee weapons, firearms with limited ammo, or powerful one-use throwables.

Players can also enjoy a diverse roster of characters, each with their own strengths and weaknesses that filling depth and variety to how you face with each mission.

With dynamic NPCs, missions, and safe zones that change on every playthrough, Possess Squad delivers endless replay-ability.
Team up with friends through local co-op for even more thrilling battles against the infected.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Windows 10 and later
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Support for OpenGL 3.3
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Processor: Windows 10 and later
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: For local multiplayer experience required at least one or more controller(s).

short_description: Possess Squad is a post-apocalyptic survival action game where you battle hordes of infected mutants, protect survivors, and fight for your place in a collapsing world. Solo or with friends in local co-op.
